GT_role: Evaluation and attribution only; never a new query guard or row selection.
inference_limits: Ground-first uses an open inferred C2 chart and fixed measured-pool road, not hidden-body truth.
A supported road ray is not proof no real foreground occludes that road.
Expected Gaussian-centre depth is not a physical first-hit measurement.
Deleted37 footprint changes can be intended road restoration; they remain failures under the unchanged original geometryguard.
Retained/protected-nonroad partitions must be reviewed separately; no blanket acceptance exception is introduced.
Missing joint per-component RGB is reported unavailable, never replaced by isolated render or W-scaled invented colour.
